# R5 D14: six further exact eight-error witnesses extend certified coverage to 26,388 pairs

Date: 2026-11-20 (Asia/Shanghai). This is continuation of the verified 52-reference D14 study, not a new native X6 or BRC theorem. Historical contribution provenance: EM-DIRECT-4C3E47; associated prior activity RA-F2257922D00B2FE4C4818DBD. Author-checked finite computation; PARTIAL_INDEPENDENT_CROSSCHECK; NOT_REVIEWED.

## Frozen scientific model

Use the *unchanged* R5 science pin `awdawmip/enterprise-math@435e77af0d180eac32bd1f9c4c464bc4010b7551`, integer input `EXACT_R5_ALL_101_BUDGETS.json` with SHA-256 `50e87f0194cfb3780e84b7bbb6f9a2dca4f79bb4901cab06f1a5b59256fb470b`. There are 256 named hypotheses; the 101 physical prices are k=214,...,314; closed scalar feedback intervals satisfy `2|y-N_h(k)| <= tau` where `tau=58182461585441404127941754879`. At most eight observations are arbitrarily wrong and are not marked.

Fix W=(0,16,32,48,1,64,17,80,18,24,34,82). For every unordered {u,v} disjoint from W, jointly construct the full fourteen-label interval support family at each k. Identical maximal families retain the minimum price; all 14 names and actual physical prices remain separate. There are 29,646 named pairs and 1,906 distinct price-aware joint signatures, with the exact deterministic class numbering of the predecessor CENSUS_14_SIGNATURES.cpp.

## The new exact finite root results

Six *additional* reference signatures were solved by complete fourteen-counter minimax Bellman recursion for error budget f=8; the rows are in ROOTS_NEW6.csv:

| class | (u,v) | V8 | Nonterminal memo states | Newly covered named pairs |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 699 | (50,81) | 8335 | 3,904,167 | 83 |
| 703 | (50,96) | 8335 | 3,027,474 | 83 |
| 923 | (66,81) | 8335 | 3,408,257 | 83 |
| 658 | (49,65) | 8335 | 2,778,921 | 81 |
| 1091 | (81,96) | 8335 | 2,455,390 | 81 |
| 1231 | (96,97) | 8335 | 2,103,657 | 81 |

The recurrence for capped mismatch counters e_i∈{0,...,9} is V(e)=0 if at most one e_i<=8, otherwise V(e)=min_k(k+max_{S∈F_k} V(e^S)). Exclude any k with a maximal joint support S containing every live name, because that branch stalls at positive cost. Every retained action strictly increments at least one live counter in every branch, proving well-foundedness of the finite recursion. For a given k, the support family is generated from the *joint* left-endpoints `2N_h(k)-tau`; keeping maximal supports is exact because every feasible observation is contained in one such support. The full 14-counter DP, not a pairwise projection, produced the six roots.

## D14 theorem and coverage certificate

D14 (exact predecessor theorem, `awdawmip/enterprise-math@c328562411f49bd9981d54b2eeb9b0220a66986c:research_notes/portable_direct/r5_fourteen_dominance_20261120/RESEARCH.md`) orders priced joint-support signatures: A≼B if each physical B-action can be simulated by an A-action of no greater cost such that each maximal A-support lies in some B-support, allowing an exchange of the two newly named coordinates. Thus V8(A)≤V8(B) by virtual-observation simulation. With the established W lower bound V8(W)=8335, any signature dominated by a 8335 root also has exactly 8335.

The already certified 52 reference classes cover 1,220 signatures and 25,896 named pairs. Rebuilding all 1,906 signatures and all 38,127 directed price-support dominance edges, then adding six roots in the order in ROOTS_NEW6.csv, certifies **45 additional signatures and 492 additional named pairs**; total **1,265 signatures and 26,388 pairs**. The remaining **641 signatures and 3,258 named pairs** are not certified by this finite collection. The full 256-label game still has known bounds 8335≤C8*≤8343; the new result increases coverage, not the strongest global lower bound.

## Validation and limitations

Original frozen integer bytes SHA-256 matched. The predecessor matrix regeneration produced 1,906 signatures and 38,127 edges. All six root calculations returned 8335 and their reported memo sizes; an *independent* doubled-left-endpoint Python action generator plus nibble-packed C++ solver separately returned 8335 for (50,81) (3,904,167 states) and (96,97) (2,103,657 states), each with seven priced actions. VERIFY_NEW6_D14.py checked each new reference identity, marginal exact cover, 26,388 total certified pairs, and 3,258 unresolved pairs.

The representative (128,144) exhausted a 9,000,000-state author cap before a result and remains unresolved; a cap is not a counterexample. The computations are author finite-evidence and partial implementation cross-check, **not** independent mathematical review. The scalar 14-bit observer is auxiliary bookkeeping and is not asserted to be a fourteen-axis native space or a lossless native X6/BRC representation. Named supports, query prices and frozen observer assumptions are retained; BRC quotient transfer would need its own joint relation/future-operation certificate.

## Reproduction and next live question

Use REPRODUCE.md, ROOTS_NEW6.csv, and VERIFY_NEW6_D14.py with the existing immutable R5 solver/oracle and complete frozen input. Research direction: attack the high-cost nine-action signatures such as (128,144), seek exact branch-and-bound or strategy-level simulation preserving all 14 named counters, and test for the first strict V8>8335 witness. No Task CLAIM/RUN, Result acceptance, or Review is asserted by this note.
